source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 20 (PDF 59-74), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 20 (Aromatic Hydrocarbons) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The molecular formula of benzene is:
(Benzene ka molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene aik ahem organic compound hai jis ka formula C₆H₆ hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Benzene is one of the most important organic compounds with the chemical formula C₆H₆.

blocks.prompt:
2 The simplest aromatic hydrocarbon is:
(Sab se saada aromatic hydrocarbon kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene, C₆H₆, sab se saada aromatic hydrocarbon hai (20.1). Cyclohexane mein benzene ring nahi; phenol hydrocarbon nahi.

book_ref.quote: It is the simplest aromatic hydrocarbon.

blocks.prompt:
3 Arenes are organic hydrocarbons that contain:
(Arenes kaun se organic hydrocarbons hain?)

options.text: open chain mein sirf single bonds
sirf sp³ carbons ka cyclic ring

blocks.explanation: Jin hydrocarbons mein aik ya ziyada benzene rings hon unhein arenes kehte hain (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Organic hydrocarbons containing one or more benzene rings are known as arenes.

blocks.prompt:
4 In the early 19th century, compounds containing benzene rings were called 'aromatic' because they were:
(19vi sadi ke shuru mein benzene ring wale compounds ko 'aromatic' kyun kaha gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene se bane products khushbu-daar hote hain, is liye unhein 'aromatic' (meethi khushbu wale) kaha gaya (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Benzene derived products are well known to be pleasantly fragrant.

blocks.prompt:
5 Today the term 'aromatic' is used for molecules that:
(Aaj kal 'aromatic' ka lafz kin molecules ke liye istemal hota hai?)

options.text: benzene ya benzene jaisi ring wale, chahe boo buri ho
meethi khushbu wale, structure jo bhi ho
carbon atoms ki koi bhi ring wale
kam az kam aik double bond wale

blocks.explanation: Ab 'aromatic' un molecules ke liye hai jin mein benzene ya benzene jaisi ring ho, chahe un ki boo buri ho (20.1).

book_ref.quote: that are not good-smelling, rather have foul smells

blocks.prompt:
6 Camphor has a strong minty aroma. This shows that:
(Camphor ki tez minty khushbu hoti hai. Is se kya pata chalta hai?)

options.text: tamaam aromatic compounds ki khushbu achhi hoti hai
khushbu se yeh sabit nahi hota ke compound aromatic hai

blocks.explanation: Camphor ki khushbu tez hai lekin is mein benzene ring nahi; is liye sirf khushbu se compound aromatic nahi banta (20.1).

book_ref.quote: Non-aromatic compounds, such as camphor, extracted from the camphor laurel tree

blocks.prompt:
7 Which of the following is given as a sweet-smelling aromatic compound?
(In mein se kaun sa meethi khushbu wala aromatic compound hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se aromatic compounds khushbu-daar hain, jaise vanilla (20.1). Camphor ki khushbu tez hai magar woh non-aromatic hai.

book_ref.quote: Many aromatic compounds are sweet/pleasant smelling, such as vanilla.

blocks.prompt:
8 The linear structures first proposed for benzene were rejected because they:
(Benzene ke liye pehle pesh kiye gaye linear structures kyun radd kar diye gaye?)

options.text: un mein carbon atoms kam thay
woh ring ki shakal mein thay
benzene ki properties samjha nahi sakte thay

blocks.explanation: Kuch scientists ne C₆H₆ ke linear structures diye, magar woh benzene ki properties samjha na sake is liye radd ho gaye (20.1).

book_ref.quote: But, these were soon rejected as they could not explain the properties of benzene.

blocks.prompt:
9 August Kekule proposed the structure of benzene in:
(August Kekule ne benzene ka structure kab pesh kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ka structure 1865 tak raaz raha, phir German professor August Kekule ne isay wazeh kiya (20.1).

book_ref.quote: until 1865 when a German professor August Kekule elucidated it

blocks.prompt:
10 According to Kekule, benzene is a:
(Kekule ke mutabiq benzene kya hai?)

options.text: chhe members ki ring jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari hain
chhe members ki ring jis mein sirf single bonds hain
seedhi chain jis mein do triple bonds hain
paanch members ki ring jis mein aik double bond hai

blocks.explanation: Kekule ne benzene ko chhe (6) members wala cyclic compound bataya jis mein single aur double bonds baari baari hain (20.1).

book_ref.quote: six membered cyclic compound having alternate single and double bonds

blocks.prompt:
11 X-ray studies show that the benzene molecule is:
(X-ray studies ke mutabiq benzene molecule kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: X-ray studies ke mutabiq benzene planar (hamwar) hai: chhe sp² carbon atoms ka regular hexagon (20.1).

book_ref.quote: planar configuration characterized by a regular hexagon

blocks.prompt:
12 The C–C–C and H–C–C bond angles in benzene are:
(Benzene mein C–C–C aur H–C–C bond angles kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon teen atoms se juda hai aur C–C–C aur H–C–C angles 120° hain (20.1).

book_ref.quote: bond angles of 120° for C–C–C and H–C–C

blocks.prompt:
13 The carbon-carbon bond length in benzene is:
(Benzene mein carbon-carbon bond length kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ke tamaam C–C bonds 139 pm hain, jo single bond (154 pm) aur double bond (133 pm) ke darmiyan hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: while the length of the C–C bond is 139 pm

blocks.prompt:
14 The C–H bond length in benzene is:
(Benzene mein C–H bond length kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene mein C–H bond ki length 109 pm (1.090 Å) hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: The length of the C–H bond is 109 pm

blocks.prompt:
15 The C–C bond length of benzene is 1.3970 Å. Since 1 Å = 100 pm, this equals:
(Benzene ki C–C bond length 1.3970 Å hai. 1 Å = 100 pm ho to yeh kitni hui?)
blocks.explanation: 1.3970 Å × 100 = 139.7 pm; chapter isay 139 pm likhta hai (20.1).

book_ref.quote: All C-C and C-H bond lengths are 1.3970 Å and 1.090 Å, respectively.

blocks.prompt:
16 The main problem with Kekule's structure was that it:
(Kekule ke structure ka bunyaadi masla kya tha?)

options.text: benzene ki physical aur chemical properties poori tarah nahi samjhata tha
chhe carbon atoms nahi dikhata tha
benzene ko seedhi chain dikhata tha

blocks.explanation: Kekule ka structure bohat si properties samjhata tha magar benzene ki physical aur chemical properties poori tarah nahi (20.1).

book_ref.quote: it didn’t fully explain the physical and chemical properties of benzene

blocks.text: 20.1.1 Thermodynamic Stability of Benzene and Resonance

blocks.prompt:
17 The heat released when cyclohexene is hydrogenated to cyclohexane is:
(Cyclohexene ki hydrogenation se cyclohexane bante waqt kitni heat nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexene (aik C=C) ki hydrogenation se cyclohexane banta hai aur 120 kJ mol⁻¹ heat nikalti hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The hydrogenation of cyclohexene results in the formation of cyclohexane and releases 120 kJ mol⁻¹ of energy.

blocks.prompt:
18 The expected heat of complete hydrogenation of cyclohexadiene is:
(Cyclohexadiene ki mukammal hydrogenation ki tawaqqo heat kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do C=C bonds × 120 kJ mol⁻¹ = 240 kJ mol⁻¹ (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: we could expect that cyclohexadiene would yield 240 kJ mol⁻¹ on complete hydrogenation

blocks.prompt:
19 The heat of hydrogenation expected for the hypothetical 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene is:
(Farzi 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene ki hydrogenation ki tawaqqo heat kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen C=C bonds × 120 kJ mol⁻¹ = 360 kJ mol⁻¹ (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: the hypothetical 1,3,5-cyclohexatriene would produce 360 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
20 The actual heat of hydrogenation of benzene is:
(Benzene ki asal heat of hydrogenation kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene hydrogenation par sirf 208 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai, 360 se bohat kam, jo is ki ghair mamooli stability dikhata hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Benzene, however, has much lower heat of hydrogenation (208 kJ mol⁻¹) exhibiting an exceptional stability.

blocks.prompt:
21 The resonance energy of benzene is:
(Benzene ki resonance energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Resonance energy = 360 − 208 = 152 kJ mol⁻¹ (20.1.1; kitab ka 158.5 ghalat chhapa hai).

book_ref.quote: The actual heat of hydrogenation of benzene is 152 kJ mol⁻¹ lower than the theoretical value.

blocks.prompt:
22 Resonance energy of benzene is also called:
(Benzene ki resonance energy ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jitni benzene ki asal heat theoretical se kam hai, woh resonance energy (delocalisation energy) kehlati hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This energy is called the resonance energy (delocalisation energy) of benzene.

blocks.prompt:
23 Cyclohexene, cyclohexadiene and benzene all give which common product on complete catalytic hydrogenation?
(Cyclohexene, cyclohexadiene aur benzene sab mukammal hydrogenation par kaun sa mushtarka product dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sab par hydrogen ke izafe se cyclohexane banta hai, jo mushtarka product aur low-energy reference point hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This reaction yields cyclohexane as a common product via catalytic addition of hydrogen.

blocks.prompt:
24 In the energy level diagram of hydrogenation (Figure 20.1), cyclohexane represents:
(Hydrogenation ke energy level diagram (Figure 20.1) mein cyclohexane kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexane mushtarka product hai, is liye yeh low-energy reference point (hawala nuqta) hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: cyclohexane symbolizes a low-energy reference point

blocks.prompt:
25 A lower heat of hydrogenation than expected shows that the compound is:
(Tawaqqo se kam heat of hydrogenation kya zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heat of hydrogenation stability se mutaliq hai; benzene ki kam heat (360 ki jagah 208) batati hai ke yeh bohat ziyada stable hai (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: These heats of hydrogenation can be related to the relative thermodynamic stability of the compounds.

blocks.prompt:
26 A cyclic alkene with one C=C releases 118 kJ mol⁻¹ on hydrogenation. An aromatic ring analogue with three such bonds releases only 205 kJ mol⁻¹. Its resonance energy is:
(Aik C=C wali cyclic alkene hydrogenation par 118 kJ mol⁻¹ deti hai. Teen aise bonds wala aromatic ring sirf 205 kJ mol⁻¹ deta hai. Is ki resonance energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tawaqqo = 3 × 118 = 354 kJ mol⁻¹; resonance energy = 354 − 205 = 149 kJ mol⁻¹ (20.1.1 ka tareeqa).

book_ref.quote: Evidence of the increased stability of benzene is obtained by measuring the heat emitted

blocks.prompt:
27 The extra stability of benzene is explained by:
(Benzene ki izafi stability ki wajah kya hai?)

options.text: ring par π electrons ki delocalisation (phailao)

blocks.explanation: Yeh stability π electrons ki delocalisation (phailao) se hai jo chhe carbons par phaile hain (20.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This stability is explained based on the delocalisation of π electrons.

blocks.prompt:
28 The hybridization of each carbon atom in benzene is:
(Benzene mein har carbon atom ki hybridization kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hybridization ke mutabiq benzene ka har carbon sp² hybridized hai (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: each carbon atom in benzene is sp² hybridized

blocks.prompt:
29 Each carbon atom of benzene forms how many σ bonds?
(Benzene ka har carbon kitne σ bonds banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har carbon ke teen sp² orbitals teen σ bonds banate hain: do saath wale carbons se aur aik hydrogen se (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: two with adjacent carbon atoms and one with a hydrogen atom

blocks.prompt:
30 The total number of σ bonds in one benzene molecule is:
(Aik benzene molecule mein kul kitne σ bonds hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ring mein chhe C–C σ bonds aur chhe C–H σ bonds: 6 + 6 = 12 (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: The three sp² hybrid orbitals on each carbon are utilized to form three σ-bonds

blocks.prompt:
31 The six unhybridized 2p orbitals in benzene are:
(Benzene ke chhe unhybridized 2p orbitals kaise hain?)

options.text: σ framework par amood aur aapas mein parallel

blocks.explanation: Har carbon ka aik 2p orbital σ framework par perpendicular (amood) aur doosron ke parallel hai, is liye sideways overlap hota hai (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: are perpendicular to this sigma framework and parallel to each other

blocks.prompt:
32 In benzene the π-electron cloud lies:
(Benzene mein π-electron cloud kahan hota hai?)

options.text: sirf C aur H ke darmiyan
C–H bonds ke saath ring se bahar
ring ke plane ke upar aur neeche

blocks.explanation: 2p orbitals ke sideways overlap se ring ke plane ke upar aur neeche π-electron cloud banta hai (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: form a π-electron cloud above and below the plane of the benzene ring

blocks.prompt:
33 How many π electrons are delocalized over the benzene ring?
(Benzene ring par kitne π electrons delocalized hain?)
blocks.explanation: Overlap ki wajah se chhe π electrons chhe carbons mein barabar share hote hain (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: six electrons are shared equally among all the six carbons

blocks.prompt:
34 In the hexagon-with-circle symbol of benzene, the circle stands for:
(Benzene ke hexagon-with-circle nishan mein circle kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene ko hexagon ke andar circle se dikhate hain; circle delocalized π electrons hai (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: where the circle represents delocalized π electrons

blocks.prompt:
35 All six C–C bond lengths in benzene are equal because of:
(Benzene ke chhe C–C bonds ki length barabar kyun hai?)

options.text: baari baari single aur double bonds

blocks.explanation: Delocalization ki wajah se chhe C–C bonds barabar (139 pm) hain; baari baari single/double bonds se do mukhtalif lengths hoti (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: This delocalization causes all the six C - C bond lengths to be same (139 pm).

blocks.prompt:
36 According to Table 20.1, the C≡C bond length is:
(Table 20.1 ke mutabiq C≡C bond length kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 20.1: C–C 154 pm, C=C 133 pm aur C≡C 120 pm (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: making it a conjugated molecule

blocks.prompt:
37 The C–H σ bond in benzene is formed by the overlap of:
(Benzene mein C–H σ bond kin orbitals ke overlap se banta hai?)

options.text: C ka sp² aur H ka sp² orbital
C ka sp² aur H ka 1s orbital
C ka 2p aur H ka 1s orbital
C ka sp³ aur H ka 1s orbital

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen apne 1s orbital se bond banata hai, is liye C–H bond sp²–s hai (20.1.2, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: hydrogen bonds with its 1s orbital, so the bond is sp2-s

blocks.prompt:
38 All carbon and hydrogen atoms of the benzene σ framework lie in one plane because:
(Benzene ke σ framework ke tamaam C aur H atoms aik plane mein kyun hain?)

options.text: hydrogen atoms π cloud ko dhakelte hain
tamaam sp² orbitals aik hi plane mein hain

blocks.explanation: Tamaam sp² orbitals aik hi plane mein hain, is liye σ framework ke atoms 120° par aik plane mein hain (20.1.2).

book_ref.quote: all the carbon and hydrogen atoms of this σ framework are coplanar at 120°

blocks.prompt:
39 Aromatic hydrocarbons containing only one benzene ring are called:
(Sirf aik benzene ring wale aromatic hydrocarbons kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik benzene ring wale aromatic hydrocarbons monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: are known as monocyclic aromatic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
40 Aromatic hydrocarbons with two or more benzene rings are called:
(Do ya ziyada benzene rings wale aromatic hydrocarbons kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do ya ziyada benzene rings wale aromatic hydrocarbons polycyclic kehlate hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: two or more benzene rings in their molecules are known as polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons

blocks.prompt:
41 Benzene derivatives are named in:
(Benzene derivatives ke naam kitne tareeqon se rakhe jate hain?)

options.text: do tareeqe: 'benzene' suffix ke saath ya khaas naam

blocks.explanation: Do tareeqe hain: 'benzene' suffix ke saath (maslan nitrobenzene) aur khaas naam (maslan phenol) (20.2).

book_ref.quote: There are two styles of naming benzene derivatives.

blocks.prompt:
42 C₆H₅NO₂ is named, with benzene as the base name:
(C₆H₅NO₂ ka naam, benzene ko base name rakh kar, kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monosubstituted benzene ka naam 'benzene' base aur substituent prefix se: nitrobenzene (20.2).

book_ref.quote: such as chlorobenzene, nitrobenzene and methyl benzene

blocks.prompt:
43 The IUPAC-accepted common base name for C₆H₅CH₃ is:
(C₆H₅CH₃ ka IUPAC mein qabool shuda aam base name kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch aam naam IUPAC base names hain: phenol (C₆H₅OH), toluene (C₆H₅CH₃), aniline (C₆H₅NH₂) (20.2).

book_ref.quote: e.g, phenol, toluene, aniline, etc.

blocks.prompt:
44 The IUPAC-accepted base name of C₆H₅NH₂ is:
(C₆H₅NH₂ ka IUPAC base name kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aniline aam naam hai jo IUPAC mein C₆H₅NH₂ ka base name hai (20.2).

book_ref.quote: some of these names have been included in IUPAC nomenclature as base names for the structure

blocks.prompt:
45 No locant number is written in the name of a monosubstituted benzene because:
(Monosubstituted benzene ke naam mein number kyun nahi likha jata?)

options.text: substituent hamesha C-1 par hota hai

blocks.explanation: Monosubstituted benzene mein substituent hamesha C-1 par hota hai, is liye number ki zaroorat nahi (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The substituent in a monosubstituted benzene is always at C-1, so there is no need to number its location.

blocks.prompt:
46 Which substituent has the highest priority for numbering a disubstituted benzene?
(Disubstituted benzene ki numbering mein kis substituent ki priority sab se ziyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Priority ki tarteeb: –COOH > –CN > –CHO > –COCH₃ > –OH > –NH₂ > –OR > –R (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The order of priority of substituents (left to right) is

blocks.prompt:
47 A benzene ring carries –OH and –NH₂ on carbons that are meta to each other. Its name is:
(Benzene ring par –OH aur –NH₂ aik doosre se meta par hain. Is ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: –OH ki priority –NH₂ se ziyada hai, is liye us ka carbon C₁ (base phenol); meta carbon C₃: 3-aminophenol (20.2).

book_ref.quote: The carbon to which a higher priority substituent is attached is C₁.

blocks.prompt:
48 A benzene ring has a bromine and a chlorine atom in 1,3 positions. Its correct name is:
(Benzene ring par bromine aur chlorine 1,3 positions par hain. Sahih naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Barabar priority par alphabet mein pehle wala (bromo, chloro se pehle) C₁ leta hai: 1-bromo-3-chlorobenzene (20.2).

book_ref.quote: If both substituents are the same priority then the carbon having a substituent lower in alphabets is designated as C₁.

blocks.prompt:
49 A benzene ring carries –COOH and –NO₂ on opposite (1,4) carbons. Its name is:
(Benzene ring par –COOH aur –NO₂ aamne saamne (1,4) carbons par hain. Is ka naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: –COOH ki sab se ziyada priority hai, woh C₁ hai (benzoic acid); –NO₂ saamne wale carbon C₄ par: 4-nitrobenzoic acid (20.2).

book_ref.quote: Common names in bold face given below are considered to be IUPAC correct base names for structures.

blocks.prompt:
50 Two substituents at positions 1 and 2 of a benzene ring are described as:
(Benzene ring ki 1 aur 2 positions par do substituents ko kya kehte hain?)

book_ref.quote: ortho- (o-), meta- (m-), or para (p-) can be used in place of positional markers

blocks.prompt:
51 Two substituents at positions 1 and 3 of a benzene ring are described as:
(Benzene ring ki 1 aur 3 positions par do substituents ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Positions 1 aur 3 aik doosre se meta (m-) hain (20.2).

book_ref.quote: Disubstituted benzenes have common names with reference to the relationship between the two substituents.

blocks.prompt:
52 1,4-Dibromobenzene is also called:
(1,4-Dibromobenzene ka doosra naam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 aur 4 par bromine atoms para hain: p-dibromobenzene (20.2, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: bromine atoms at positions 1 and 4 are para (1,4)

blocks.text: 20.3 Comparison of Reactivity of Benzene with Alkanes and Alkenes

blocks.prompt:
53 Alkanes are generally unreactive because they:
(Alkanes aam tor par reactive kyun nahi hote?)

options.text: non-polar hain aur sirf σ bonds rakhte hain

blocks.explanation: Alkanes non-polar hain aur un mein sirf σ bonds hain, is liye reactive nahi (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Alkanes are generally an unreactive class of organic compounds due to their non-polar nature and the presence of sigma bond only.

blocks.prompt:
54 In the presence of UV light, alkanes readily undergo:
(UV light mein alkanes aasani se kaun sa reaction karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Alkanes UV light mein free radical substitution aasani se karte hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: they undergo free radical substitution reactions in the presence of UV light quite easily

blocks.prompt:
55 Alkenes are very reactive and typically undergo:
(Alkenes bohat reactive hain aur aam tor par kaun sa reaction karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: π bond aur maujood π electrons ki wajah se alkenes electrophilic addition aasani se karte hain (20.3).

book_ref.quote: They undergo electrophilic addition reactions easily.

blocks.prompt:
56 With electrophiles, benzene usually undergoes:
(Electrophiles ke saath benzene aam tor par kaun sa reaction karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Alkenes ke bar-aks benzene electrophilic substitution karta hai, addition nahi (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Unlike alkenes, it undergoes the electrophilic substitution and not electrophilic addition reactions

blocks.prompt:
57 Electrophilic addition to benzene is not favourable because it:
(Benzene par electrophilic addition kyun pasandeeda nahi?)

options.text: ring ki delocalisation hamesha ke liye toot jati

blocks.explanation: Addition mein delocalisation toot jati hai; substitution mein aakhir mein wapas aa jati hai, is liye ring stable rehti hai (20.3).

book_ref.quote: In electrophilic addition the delocalisation is broken and addition is not favourable.

blocks.prompt:
58 When benzene reacts with bromine in electrophilic substitution, a bromine atom:
(Benzene ki bromine ke saath electrophilic substitution mein bromine atom kya karta hai?)

options.text: ring ke aik hydrogen ki jagah leta hai
double bond par add hota hai
aik carbon ki jagah leta hai
ring ka satwan atom ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Electrophilic substitution mein bromine ring ke aik hydrogen ki jagah leta hai aur aromatic ring qaim rehti hai (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Bromine in the electrophilic substitution reaction replaces a hydrogen atom.

blocks.prompt:
59 Which compound adds bromine readily without a halogen carrier?
(Kaun sa compound halogen carrier ke baghair bromine aasani se add karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cyclohexene bromine aasani se add karta hai; benzene yeh addition nahi karta (20.3, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: but cyclohexene adds bromine readily

blocks.prompt:
60 Benzene resembles alkenes in that it:
(Benzene alkenes se kis baat mein milta hai?)

options.text: UV light mein free radical substitution karta hai
electrophilic species se react karta hai
non-polar hai aur sirf σ bonds rakhta hai
room temperature par bromine aasani se add karta hai

blocks.explanation: Benzene ke teen π bonds hain aur alkenes ki tarah electrophiles se react karta hai, magar substitution karta hai (20.3).

book_ref.quote: Benzene has three π bonds and, as expected, shows some similarities to alkenes

blocks.prompt:
61 The general mechanism of electrophilic aromatic substitution has how many main steps?
(Electrophilic aromatic substitution ke aam mechanism ke kitne bunyaadi steps hain?)
blocks.explanation: Steps: electrophile banana, electrophilic hamla, aromaticity wapas laana (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the electrophilic aromatic substitution mechanism can be divided into three main steps

blocks.prompt:
62 In electrophilic aromatic substitution the electrophile can be:
(Electrophilic aromatic substitution mein electrophile kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: positive ion ya polar molecule ka positive sira

blocks.explanation: Electrophile positive ion ya polar molecule ka positive sira ho sakta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The electrophile can be a positive ion or the positive end of a polar molecule.

blocks.prompt:
63 The electrophile in these reactions is usually:
(In reactions mein electrophile aam tor par kaise milta hai?)

options.text: khalis shakal mein seedha dala jata hai
munasib reagents se mixture ke andar (in situ) banaya jata hai
sirf benzene garam karne se banta hai

blocks.explanation: Electrophile seedha nahi dala ja sakta; munasib reagents dal kar mixture ke andar (in situ) banaya jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The electrophile is produced in situ, by adding appropriate reagents to the reaction mixture.

blocks.prompt:
64 The intermediate formed when the π electrons of benzene attack the electrophile is called:
(Benzene ke π electrons ke electrophile par hamle se banne wala intermediate kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ring carbon aur electrophile ke darmiyan naya σ bond banta hai, is liye intermediate sigma complex kehlata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Because of the new sigma bond formed, this intermediate is called a sigma complex.

blocks.prompt:
65 In the sigma complex, the number of π electrons left in the ring is:
(Sigma complex mein ring ke paas kitne π electrons reh jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aromaticity toot jati hai: sirf chaar π electrons rehte hain aur positive charge paanch carbons par phaila hota hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: there are now only four π electrons and there is a positive charge spread over the five carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
66 In the sigma complex, the ring carbon carrying both H and the electrophile is:
(Sigma complex mein woh ring carbon jis par H aur electrophile dono hain, kaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrophile aur H wala carbon sp³ hai; step 3 mein us ka H counterion/conjugate base nikalta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the hydrogen on the sp³-hybridized carbon is removed by a counterion/conjugate base

blocks.prompt:
67 Aromaticity is restored in the last step by:
(Aakhri step mein aromaticity kaise wapas aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: H heterolytic cleavage (ghair barabar toot) se nikalta hai; us ke electrons π system mein wapas jate hain (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This happens by heterolytic cleavage of the C-H bond.

blocks.prompt:
68 Benzene undergoes substitution with bromine or chlorine only in the presence of:
(Benzene bromine ya chlorine se substitution sirf kis ki maujoodgi mein karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Benzene bromine aur chlorine se sirf Lewis acid ki maujoodgi mein react karta hai jo taqatwar electrophile banata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Benzene only reacts with bromine and chlorine in the presence of Lewis acids

blocks.prompt:
69 Which of the following is NOT one of the Lewis acids named for halogenation of benzene?
(Benzene ki halogenation ke liye bataye gaye Lewis acids mein se kaun sa nahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam Lewis acids AlCl₃, FeCl₃ ya FeBr₃ hain (20.3.1). NaCl yahan Lewis acid catalyst nahi.

book_ref.quote: The Lewis acids are usually aluminum chloride (AlCl₃), iron chloride (FeCl₃) or iron bromide (FeBr₃).

blocks.prompt:
70 In the bromination of benzene with Br₂ and AlBr₃, the electrophile is:
(Br₂ aur AlBr₃ se benzene ki bromination mein electrophile kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: AlBr₃ Br₂ ko polarise kar ke electrophile Br⁺ banata hai, phir aam mechanism chalta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Once the electrophile is formed, it follows the same general mechanism as we have discussed earlier.

blocks.prompt:
71 In bromination with AlBr₃, the proton is removed from the sigma complex by:
(AlBr₃ ke saath bromination mein sigma complex se proton kaun nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bromination mein sigma complex ka proton [AlBr₄]⁻ nikalta hai, HBr banta hai aur AlBr₃ wapas milta hai (20.3.1, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: In bromination the sigma complex is deprotonated by [AlBr₄]⁻

blocks.prompt:
72 When Br₂ is polarised by the Lewis acid, its partial charges are written as:
(Lewis acid se polarise hone par Br₂ ke partial charges kaise likhe jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Partial charges δ+ aur δ− likhe jate hain (20.3.1, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: partial charges are δ+ and δ−

blocks.prompt:
73 In the chlorination of benzene, the electrophile Cl⁺ is generated using:
(Benzene ki chlorination mein electrophile Cl⁺ kis se banaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: FeCl₃ Lewis acid activator ke tor par Cl⁺ banata hai; baaqi mechanism bromination jaisa hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: FeCl₃ is used as the Lewis acid activator for generating Cl⁺

blocks.prompt:
74 The nitrating mixture used to introduce a nitro group on benzene is:
(Benzene par nitro group lagane ke liye kaun sa mixture istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitro group conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke mixture se lagaya jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: using mixture of conc. HNO₃ and conc. H₂SO₄

blocks.prompt:
75 The electrophile in the nitration of benzene is:
(Benzene ki nitration mein electrophile kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electrophile NO₂⁺ conc. HNO₃ aur conc. H₂SO₄ ke reaction se banta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The electrophile NO₂⁺ ion is generated by reacting concentrated nitric acid

blocks.prompt:
76 If benzene is nitrated at a higher temperature:
(Agar benzene ki nitration ziyada temperature par ki jaye to kya hota hai?)

options.text: aik se ziyada nitro group lagne ka imkaan hai

blocks.explanation: Ziyada temperature par aik se ziyada nitro groups lagne ka imkaan barh jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: At higher temperatures there is a greater chance of getting more than one nitro group substituted onto the ring.

blocks.prompt:
77 The dinitro product formed in small amount even at 50 °C during nitration of benzene is:
(50 °C par bhi benzene ki nitration mein thori miqdaar mein kaun sa dinitro product banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 50 °C par bhi kuch 1,3-dinitrobenzene banta hai; –NO₂ meta director hai (20.3.1, 20.4).

book_ref.quote: You will get a certain amount of 1,3-dinitrobenzene formed even at 50°C.

blocks.prompt:
78 Friedel-Crafts alkylation introduces into the benzene ring:
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation benzene ring mein kya dakhil karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein alkyl group benzene ring mein lagaya jata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: In the Friedel-Crafts alkylation, an alkyl group is substituted into the benzene ring.

blocks.prompt:
79 An acyl group is:
(Acyl group kya hai?)

options.text: oxygen se juda alkyl group, R–O–
sirf carbonyl se juda benzene ring
carbonyl group se juda alkyl group, R–C=O

blocks.explanation: Acyl group woh alkyl group hai jo carbonyl group se juda ho, R–C=O (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: An acyl group is an alkyl group attached to a carbonyl group, R-C=O.

blocks.prompt:
80 In Friedel-Crafts alkylation, the electrophile formed from the alkyl halide and AlCl₃ is:
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein alkyl halide aur AlCl₃ se kaun sa electrophile banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: AlCl₃ alkyl halide se react kar ke carbocation banata hai jo electrophile hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: resulting in the formation of a carbocation which acts as an electrophile

blocks.prompt:
81 In Friedel-Crafts acylation, the electrophile is:
(Friedel-Crafts acylation mein electrophile kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: AlCl₃ acyl halide se complex banata hai jo halide ion kho kar acylium ion RCO⁺ banata hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: the acyl halide loses a halide ion, forming an acylium ion

blocks.prompt:
82 In Friedel-Crafts alkylation, the AlCl₃ catalyst is regenerated when:
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein AlCl₃ catalyst kab wapas banta hai?)

options.text: carbocation chloride se jud jata hai
benzene aik electron kho deta hai
intermediate se nikla proton HCl banata hai

blocks.explanation: Arenium ion ka proton nikalne se aromaticity wapas aati hai; yeh proton HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas milta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: This proton goes on to form hydrochloric acid, regenerating the AlCl₃ catalyst.

blocks.prompt:
83 When the benzene ring attacks the carbocation in Friedel-Crafts alkylation, the arenium ion intermediate:
(Friedel-Crafts alkylation mein ring ke carbocation par hamle se banne wala arenium ion kaisa hai?)

options.text: waqti tor par aromaticity kho chuka hai
do π electrons haasil kar chuka hai

blocks.explanation: π electrons ke hamle se arenium ion banta hai; aromaticity waqti tor par khatam aur proton nikalne par wapas (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: The aromaticity of the arene is temporarily lost

blocks.prompt:
84 Benzene reacts with chloroethane (CH₃CH₂Cl) in the presence of AlCl₃. The organic product is:
(Benzene AlCl₃ ki maujoodgi mein chloroethane (CH₃CH₂Cl) se react karta hai. Organic product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh Friedel-Crafts alkylation hai: ethyl carbocation ring mein lagta hai, C₆H₅CH₂CH₃ aur HCl bante hain (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: In the Friedel-Crafts acylation reaction, an acyl group is substituted into the benzene ring

blocks.prompt:
85 The product of Friedel-Crafts acylation of benzene with an acyl chloride RCOCl is:
(Benzene ki RCOCl acyl chloride ke saath Friedel-Crafts acylation ka product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Friedel-Crafts acylation se acyl benzene C₆H₅COR banta hai; proton HCl banata hai aur AlCl₃ wapas milta hai (20.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the required acyl benzene product is obtained via the Friedel-Crafts acylation reaction.

blocks.prompt:
86 The position taken by a second incoming electrophile on a substituted benzene is decided by:
(Substituted benzene par doosra aane wala electrophile kis position par jaye ga, yeh kaun tay karta hai?)

options.text: ring par pehle se laga group

blocks.explanation: Ring par pehle se laga group electrophilic substitution par asar dalta hai aur orientation tay karta hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: determines the orientation of the substitution

blocks.prompt:
87 Meta-directing groups are mostly:
(Meta-directing groups zyada tar kaise hote hain?)

options.text: electron-withdrawing groups jo arenium ion ko destabilize karte hain
electron-donating groups jo arenium ion ko stabilize karte hain
aise groups jin ka reactivity par asar nahi

blocks.explanation: Meta directors zyada tar electron-withdrawing hain; arenium intermediate ko kamzor karte hain aur ring ko deactivate (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Such groups are mostly electron-withdrawing groups, that destabilize the arenium intermediate.

blocks.prompt:
88 A meta-directing group makes the benzene ring:
(Meta-directing group benzene ring ko kaisa banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meta director ring ko benzene se kam reactive banata hai aur electrophile ko meta par bhejta hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Group that makes the ring less reactive than benzene

blocks.prompt:

(In mein se kaun sa meta-directing group hai?)
blocks.explanation: Meta directors: –CN, C=O, –NO₂, –CO₂– (20.4). –OH, –NR₂ aur –R ortho-para directors hain.

book_ref.quote: include -CN, C=O, -NO₂, -CO₂-

blocks.prompt:
90 The major product of chlorination of nitrobenzene is:
(Nitrobenzene ki chlorination ka bara product kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: –NO₂ meta director hai, is liye nitrobenzene ki chlorination meta (1,3) par hoti hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: its chlorination occurs at the meta position

blocks.prompt:
91 Which of the following is an ortho-para directing group?
(In mein se kaun sa ortho-para directing group hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ortho-para directors: –SR, –R, –OH, –OR, –NR₂, –SH (20.4); –CN, –NO₂ aur C=O meta directors hain.

book_ref.quote: are -SR, -R, -OH, -OR, -NR₂, -SH

blocks.prompt:
92 Ortho-para directing groups have the ability to:
(Ortho-para directing groups ki kya salahiyat hai?)

options.text: π electrons hamesha ke liye nikalna

blocks.explanation: Ortho-para directors ring ko electrons de sakte hain; yeh ring ko activate karte hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: Note that these are groups that have the ability to donate electrons to the benzene ring.

blocks.prompt:
93 With an ortho-para director on the ring, the meta product is:
(Ring par ortho-para director ho to meta product kitna banta hai?)

options.text: bohat hi kam miqdaar ka zimni product

blocks.explanation: Ortho-para director ke saath ortho aur para products ziyada bante hain (para ko thori tarjeeh); meta bohat kam banta hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: and the meta- product is an extremely minor byproduct

blocks.prompt:
94 Between the ortho and para products of an ortho-para director, there is a slight preference for:
(Ortho-para director ke ortho aur para products mein se kis ko thori tarjeeh hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ortho-para directors ortho (1,2) ya para (1,4) product dete hain, para ko thori tarjeeh ke saath (20.4).

book_ref.quote: A group that makes the ring more reactive than benzene

blocks.prompt:
95 Ring chlorination of methylbenzene gives a mixture of:
(Methylbenzene ki ring chlorination se kaun sa mixture banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methyl group 2,4-directing hai, is liye chlorine se 2-chloro aur 4-chloromethylbenzene bante hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: a mixture of 2-chloromethylbenzene and 4-chloromethylbenzene

blocks.prompt:
96 The conditions for chlorinating the ring of methylbenzene are:
(Methylbenzene ki ring ki chlorination ki shiraait kya hain?)

options.text: AlCl₃ ya iron, UV light nahi, room temperature

blocks.explanation: Methylbenzene ki ring chlorination AlCl₃ (ya iron) ke saath, UV light ke baghair, room temperature par hoti hai (20.4).

book_ref.quote: The reactions take place at room temperature.

blocks.prompt:
97 In phenol, incoming electrophiles tend to go to positions:
(Phenol mein aane wale electrophiles kin positions par jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: OH group ring activator hai; aane wale groups 2, 4 aur 6 positions par jate hain (20.4).

book_ref.quote: OH group is also ring activator so incoming groups will tend to go into the 2, 4 & 6 positions on the ring

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Har substitution mein aik H ki jagah Cl aur aik HCl: 2C₆H₅CH₃ + 2Cl₂ → isomers + 2HCl (20.4, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: it is drawn with 2 methylbenzene + 2Cl2

blocks.prompt:
99 When benzene burns in excess air, the products are:

blocks.explanation: Ziyada hawa mein benzene mukammal oxidize ho kar CO₂ aur H₂O banata hai (20.4.1).

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Benzene ka dhuwen wala shola aromatic compounds ke test ke tor par istemal hota hai (20.4.1).

book_ref.quote: this reaction gives a smoky flame which is used as a test for aromatic compounds

ring ke carbons sp³ ban jate hain
π electrons ring chhor dete hain
alkyl group ionic ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Jab dono mil jayen to ring se juda benzylic carbon ziyada reactive aur oxidation ke qabil ho jata hai (20.4.2).

blocks.prompt:

116 Although hydrogenation of benzene is exothermic overall, it needs harsher conditions because:

117 Addition reactions of benzene:

ring ke hydrogen atoms ki jagah lete hain

book_ref.quote: The complete chlorination of benzene is shown below:

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: Chlorine and bromine react in the same way.

blocks.prompt:
121 Complete hydrogenation of methylbenzene gives:

blocks.prompt:
